key.name: window-width
key.description: Width of the main window in pixels. The application saves it when the window closes.

key.name: window-height
key.description: Height of the main window in pixels. The application saves it when the window closes.

key.name: window-maximized
key.description: Set to true if the main window was maximized when it closed.

key.name: volume
key.description: Volume of the last session. Use 0.0 for silence and 1.0 for full volume.

key.name: quit-on-close
key.description: If true, the application stops when the user closes the window. If false, it continues to play in the background.

key.name: show-notifications
key.description: If true, the application shows a notification when the track changes while the window is closed.

key.name: mini-player
key.description: If true, a small player window opens when the user closes the main window and the application continues to play in the background. The key has no effect when quit-on-close is true.

key.name: background-denied
key.description: Set to true when the background portal refused to let the application run in the background. The application shows a message at the next start and sets the key to false.

key.name: color-scheme
key.description: Light or dark style of the application. The value "system" follows the style of the desktop.

key.name: accent-color
key.description: Accent color of the application. The value "system" follows the accent color of the desktop. The other values are fixed colors.

key.name: check-updates
key.description: If true, the application checks for a new version at start-up.

key.name: last-update-check
key.summary: Time of the last update check
key.description: Unix time, in seconds, of the last update check. The value 0 means that no check was done.

key.name: api-cache-max-mb
key.summary: Size limit of the API cache
key.description: Maximum size of the cache for API responses, in mebibytes. The application removes the oldest entries when the cache is larger.

key.name: artwork-cache-max-mb
key.summary: Size limit of the artwork cache
key.description: Maximum size of the cache for artwork images, in mebibytes. The application removes the oldest files at start-up when the cache is larger.

key.name: library-disclaimer-version
key.summary: Accepted version of the library functions message
key.description: Version of the message about the library functions that Apple does not offer to other apps. The application shows the message after sign-in when this value is lower than the version in the application. The value 0 means that the user did not accept any version.
